review_type: Bounded AI-assisted implementation/self-audit; not independent specialist certification.
scope: Boundary framework iterations 0.1–0.8; not a review of every historical Cartier–Miller extension.

platform_evidence.user_reported_later_laptop_runs: Reported successes, including 0.6–0.8; current-version logs not supplied.

findings.finding: Public interfaces were spread across modules.
findings.resolution: cartier_miller.py provides one documented import/command facade; delegated service contracts retained.

findings.finding: Deeply nested malformed profile JSON escaped the intended fallback.
findings.resolution: RecursionError converted to the profile-invalid path; regression test added.

findings.finding: An unavailable implementation source during profile matching escaped the intended fallback.
findings.resolution: Profile source-unavailable fallback added; mathematical/resource checks remain active.

findings.finding: Release evidence lacked a single portable capture and frozen runtime check.
findings.resolution: Runtime manifest before/after execution, retained-source verification, environment/step logs and a checksummed ZIP, including failed-run evidence.

findings.finding: Performance evidence was distributed among successive releases.
findings.resolution: All eight suites rerun at the candidate version; current and historical evidence separated; scalar, complete-output, calibration and memory counts distinguished.

findings.finding: No current-candidate native Windows execution was available to inspect.
findings.resolution: release_check.bat captures the exact candidate on the laptop. Historical 0.1 logs and user reports of later runs are not promoted to current-candidate proof.

findings.finding: Retained native prefix mathematics remains unrefereed; this audit is AI-assisted self-review.
findings.resolution: Research-release candidate designation retained. Finite checks and elementary proof notes do not substitute for independent specialist review.

findings.finding: Sparse forest evaluation and profile lookup can be slower than explicit native evaluation.
findings.resolution: Explicit routes retained; sparse/overhead controls included in current measurements; no uniform speedup claimed.

findings.finding: Modulo-p formulas do not justify precision-two transfer.
findings.resolution: All interfaces reject other modulus powers; broader project prime-power/CUDA work remains outside this candidate.
